description: Create the /Anindita/ folder and generate Anindita-content-day1.html with a full day content plan (06:00-22:00, 17 posts). Day 1 theme: First day as content creator - Anindita starts her journey, nervous but excited, exploring her neighborhood in Tangerang, trying to take her first content photos at various spots. Outfit Set 1 (06:00-16:00): Korean girly casual daywear. Outfit Set 2 (17:00-22:00): Cute evening outfit. Captions should be a mix of funny, relatable, galau, puitis. Each post has a caption (FB style), image prompt (describing Anindita with specific outfit doing specific activity), Pinterest reference links, and copy/hide buttons.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/M-App/Anindita/Anindita-content-day1.html following EXACTLY the same HTML structure, CSS, and JavaScript as /projects/sandbox/M-App/Anindita-content-day2.html
Subtitle: mention Tangerang area and princess girl content creator theme
Schedule nav: links from 06:00 to 22:00 (17 time slots, every hour)
Outfit section: Set 1 (06:00-16:00) Korean girly casual - describe specific outfit. Set 2 (17:00-22:00) evening cute outfit - describe specific outfit

Generate 17 post cards (post-0600 through post-2200) each with: unique engaging FB caption (mix of kocak/puitis/galau/iseng/ngasal styles), detailed image prompt following the format 'Anindita pakai outfit image 2, (action) (location) (supporting details) (optional: people in background) (lighting)', 2-3 Pinterest search links relevant to outfit/location/props, 1 Google image search link

Day 1 storyline: Anindita decides to start her content creator journey. Morning at home getting ready, goes out to explore Tangerang spots for photos, visits a cafe, walks around BSD area, tries her first photoshoot at various locations, evening she reviews her content at home. Make it a connected narrative throughout the day.
Ensure localStorage key uses 'anindita-day1-task-' prefix for persistence
All captions should feel authentic to a 20yo Indonesian college girl - mix of Bahasa Indonesia casual/slang
